about.seoDesc: Niv0, artist and producer from Villa Mercedes, San Luis: his story and his discography.
about.title: niv0
story: Niv0 is an artist and music producer from Villa Mercedes, San Luis, Argentina. His influences and his sound are shaped above all by rock, trap and alternative hip hop.
A lover of beat making, guitar, writing, composing, art and, above all, music as a bridge.

He has worked with leading artists from his province's local scene and from today's emerging Argentine scene in Buenos Aires, and he keeps experimenting and looking for challenging artistic expression on every level.
He doesn't want to be pigeonholed or to be part of whatever the hegemony of the moment is. He is always working to break his own methods and rethink himself to reach more honest expression.
For him, music is made with the heart, not the head: it is all about getting something across and, above all, about INSPIRING.
